note: Benton County MO only offers its assessor GIS via a viewer (bentoncogis.com / benton.integritygis.com) backed by services.integritygis.com, which is unreachable (all requests fail across 3 attempts, incl. validator); fuller data needs a $20/month subscription, SAM GeoHub is login-gated, and the state statewide layer has only state-owned parcels. No other public parcel service or download found.
